meta_description: Adwick Projects is your trusted plumber in Scunthorpe. Emergency repairs, installations, and maintenance. Fast response, fair prices. Call now.
hero_subhead: Burst pipes, blocked drains, boiler repairs — we're here fast, any time of day or night.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full system installations, we handle every plumbing job with speed and skill.

services.title: Emergency Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast. We aim to arrive within the hour and get your water running again same day.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Service
services.desc: New boiler fitted, serviced, or repaired. All work comes with a safety certificate and we'll help you understand your warranty.

services.title: Central Heating
services.desc: Radiator repairs, bleeding, and full system upgrades. We diagnose the fault quickly and explain your options upfront.

services.title: Drain Cleaning & Unblocking
services.desc: Blocked toilets, sinks, and soil pipes cleared with professional equipment. We locate the problem and clear it without fuss.

services.title: Bathroom Installation
services.desc: Complete bathroom suites fitted to your specification. From pipework to final touch-ups, we manage every stage professionally.

services.title: Tap & Shower Repairs
services.desc: Leaking taps, faulty showers, and mixer valve replacements. Quick fixes that save you money on wasted water.

about_pullquote: We're here because Scunthorpe deserves a plumber who shows up on time and charges fair prices.
about_para_1: Adwick Projects was founded on a simple idea: be the plumber you'd want to call at midnight. Over 15 years, we've built our reputation on fast response times, honest pricing, and reliable work across Scunthorpe and the surrounding area. Every job gets the same attention, whether it's a burst pipe on Christmas Day or a routine boiler service.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because they know we'll turn up when we say we will, explain what's wrong without jargon, and fix it right the first time. We carry parts on the van for most common jobs, so you're not left waiting or paying call-out fees for nothing. That's the Adwick Projects promise.
reviews_heading: What Scunthorpe Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with a frozen pipe in January. Called Adwick at 10pm and they were round by 11. Dave got it thawed and working again by half past. Fair price, friendly bloke, and didn't make a mess. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Needed a new boiler fitted before winter. From the free quote to the final paperwork, everything was straightforward. They explained what needed doing and why. Very professional. Our heating bill's already lower.
reviews.author: Linda P.

reviews.text: Emergency call-out for a burst radiator on a Sunday. I expected to be quoted the earth, but the price was reasonable and they repaired it on the spot. Couldn't fault them. Exactly the kind of local tradesperson you want.
reviews.author: Robert M.
